meta.name: PCCP-Bench candidate pool v1 (unfrozen)
meta.status: CANDIDATE — not frozen, not published, not part of archive 0.1.3
meta.annotator: single (LGD), awaiting independent second annotator per annotation/ANNOTATION_PROTOCOL_v1.md
meta.rule: 每一道题必须能逐字引到决策文件原句；引不到就不建题
meta.note: K243684 与 K251456 是同一器械的两代（BrightHeart 先 K243684 后 K251456），两代同时入池是为了测“同一器械跨代修改”的一致性，不是重复计数

cases.device: BrightHeart View Classifier v1.1 (fetal ultrasound view classification)
cases.change: 用新采集数据重训模型权重与检测阈值，发布前把新模型与原模型的性能指标做比较，并完成验证与确认
cases.cite: Modification of training and/or validation datasets to update model weights and detection thresholds … followed by performance testing and a comparison of the original BrightHeart View Classifier to the modified BrightHeart View Classifier (using performance metrics) and verification and validation.

cases.change: 新增对 Canon、Fujifilm、SIUI 三家超声机的支持（此前只验证过 GE / Philips / Samsung / Siemens）
cases.cite: Modification of data input sources: ultrasound machine make (Canon, Fujifilm, SIUI) — Improvement in the view classification performance with ultrasound machine makes not previously validated.

cases.change: 新增两个标准切面：心室水平短轴、房室瓣水平短轴
cases.cite: Addition of standard views (short-axis view at the level of the ventricles and short-axis view at the level of the atrioventricular valves).

cases.change: 重训后直接发布新版本：没有与原模型做性能指标比较，也没有验证与确认记录
cases.cite: … followed by performance testing and a comparison of the original BrightHeart View Classifier to the modified BrightHeart View Classifier (using performance metrics) and verification and validation.
cases.note: PCCP 把“比较 + 验证”写成该类的必要条件；缺步骤即不满足，但不是范围外

cases.change: 把适用范围扩到经阴道探头（原器械仅验证并仅限经腹探头）
cases.cite: BrightHeart View Classifier was validated with pregnancies at 18 weeks of gestation or later recorded with transabdominal probes and is intended to be used only for such examinations.
cases.note: PCCP 四条修改均未涉及探头类型；范围外即新申报

cases.change: 扩充训练与性能数据：增加钆对比剂种类、增加患者年龄（婴幼儿与儿童）、增加临床病种、增加扫描机型
cases.cite: Improvements planned include additional training and/or performance data to add more gadolinium-based contrast agents, add additional patient ages (infants and children), add additional clinical conditions, and add additional scanner models.

cases.change: 新增可选的血管抑制预处理模块（降低血管显影、提升主观图像质量）
cases.cite: Additionally, an optional pre-processing feature is planned that consists of an algorithm which will suppress vessel enhancement of the AiMIFY AI/ML model … subject to the same performance testing endpoints and acceptance criteria as the cleared version of the device, along with the additional endpoints …

cases.change: 为缩短处理时间改用增加输出通道的重训模型，但未按原端点与验收判据重做性能测试
cases.cite: The AiMIFY AI/ML model is planned to be retrained with additional output channels to reduce processing time, and shall be subject to the same performance testing endpoints and acceptance criteria as the cleared version of the device.

cases.change: 把适应证从脑部 MRI 扩到脊柱 MRI
cases.cite: None of the changes shall result in a change to the Indications for Use, Cautions, performance endpoints, or acceptance criteria of AiMIFY.

cases.change: 放宽验收判据（把 CNR 提升阈值下调，以便更容易通过）
cases.cite: None of the changes shall result in a change to the … performance endpoints, or acceptance criteria of AiMIFY.

cases.change: 新增 GE 乳腺机支持（无需重训），并以 5 位放射科医师视觉评估做一致性测试，二次加权 kappa 须优于 0.85
cases.cite: Modification 1: Support of GE mammograms (no re-training required) … Agreement testing against the visual assessment of 5 radiologists on GE mammograms … Quadratic kappa on GE mammograms superior to 0.85.

cases.change: 新增 Siemens 乳腺机支持（需重训），并以非劣于已放行器械为验收判据
cases.cite: Modification 2: Support of Siemens mammograms (re-training required) … on Siemens mammograms non-inferior to the comparator device (K241561) on Hologic mammograms.

cases.change: 把骨干网络改为无监督预训练（计划内），但跳过与 5 位放射科医师的一致性测试
cases.cite: Modification 3: Pre-training of backbone using Unsupervised Machine Learning (as opposed to Supervised Machine Learning) … Agreement testing against the visual assessment of 5 radiologists …

cases.change: 新增一个计划里没写的厂商（如 Fujifilm）的乳腺机支持
cases.cite: The table below explains, for each Predetermined change, the data used for development/modification and testing, and the monitoring methodology. — 表内仅列 GE、Siemens 与骨干预训练三项。
cases.note: 计划未列即范围外；引文为说明句而非被否决的直接原文，本池最弱一条，建议重做或撤掉

cases.change: 把支持范围扩到此前未验证的妊娠年龄段，重训后用性能指标与原模型比较并完成验证与确认
cases.cite: Modification of data input sources: gestational age | Enables the device to achieve sufficient view classification performance … for examinations corresponding to gestational ages not previously validated. | Re-training of the BrightHeart View Classifier with data from new gestational ages … followed by performance testing and a comparison of the original … and verification and validation.

cases.change: 扩妊娠年龄段只加数据、不重训也不与原模型比较就发布
cases.cite: Re-training of the BrightHeart View Classifier with data from new gestational ages to optimize its performance followed by performance testing and a comparison of the original BrightHeart View Classifier to the modified BrightHeart View Classifier (using performance metrics) and verification and validation.

cases.change: 允许用户在设备内修改 AI 生成的标注 DICOM
cases.cite: Annotated DICOM files generated by the device cannot be modified by the user.

cases.change: 把用户人群扩到非专业人员/非产前超声环境（如助产士自助使用）
cases.cite: BrightHeart View Classifier is intended to be used by qualified, trained healthcare professional personnel in a professional prenatal ultrasound (US) imaging environment (this includes sonographers, MFMs, OB/GYN, and Fetal surgeons).

cases.device: Clarius OB AI（便携超声胎儿生物测量）
cases.change: 把模型用到更新款、已 510(k) 清关的 Clarius 扫描仪上（重训 + 内部测试 + 临床性能验证）
cases.cite: Modification of data input sources | To enable use of Clarius Scanner system OB AI on newer models of the 510(k)-cleared Clarius Ultrasound … Re-training of the OB AI model to expand its use with new data sources (i.e., new 510(k)-cleared models of the Clarius Ultrasound Scanner), internal testing, and clinical performance testing (verification and validation).

cases.change: 修改模型架构（重训 + 与原模型比较 + 临床验证）
cases.cite: Modification of model architecture | Re-training of the OB AI model with new data to optimize its performance followed by internal testing and a comparison of the original OB AI model to the modified OB AI model (using performance metrics) and clinical performance testing (verification and validation).

cases.change: 只改后处理算法把图像看着更顺眼，不做与原模型的性能比较、也不做临床验证
cases.cite: Modification of post-processing algorithms | Improvement and optimization of Clarius OB AI’s performance and robustness — 该类的 Testing Methods 同样要求 “Internal testing and a comparison of the original OB AI model to the modified OB AI model (using performance metrics) and clinical performance testing (verification and validation).”

cases.change: 把 OB AI 用到非 Clarius 的第三方超声机（如 GE、Philips 机器）
cases.cite: Clarius OB AI is incorporated into the Clarius App software, which is compatible with iOS and Android operating systems … and is intended for use with the following Clarius Ultrasound Scanner system transducer (previously 510(k)-cleared in K213436). Clarius OB AI is not a stand-alone software device.

cases.change: 从 B 模式扩到彩色多普勒/弹性成像模式下的自动测量
cases.cite: Clarius OB AI is intended for use in B-Mode only.

cases.change: 从凸阵探头扩到线阵/相控阵探头采集的数据
cases.cite: Clarius OB AI is intended to assist in measurements of fetal biometric parameters … on ultrasound data acquired by the Clarius Ultrasound Scanner (i.e., curvilinear scanner).
